def bash(self, command: str) -> str:
    """Execute bash command with logging."""
    log_msg = f"Bash command: {command}"
    print(f"{CYAN}{log_msg}{RESET}")

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            command,
            shell=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=60,
            cwd=THEPOD
        )
        output = result.stdout
        if result.stderr:
            output += f"\nSTDERR: {result.stderr}"
        return output if output else "✓ Command executed"
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        return f"Error executing bash command: {command}\n{CYAN}Stderr:{RESET}\n{e.stderr}"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Unexpected error: {e}"

Improvement: Optimize model loading by preloading common models.

Why: Preloading commonly used models can reduce the time taken for model initialization, especially if these models are large.

Specific code change:

```python
class ModelLoader:
    _preloaded_models = {
        "qwen-3b": AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODELS_DIR / "qwen-3b"),
        "coder": AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODELS_DIR / "coder"),
        "reasoner": AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODELS_DIR / "reasoner")
    }

    @classmethod
    def get_model(cls, name):
        if name in cls._preloaded_models:
            return cls._preloaded_models[name]
        else:
            model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODELS_DIR / name)
            cls._preloaded_models[name] = model
            return model
```
